case.title: Participant: 4 submissions within 15 minutes stays under the participant threshold of 5

submissions.open_text: Rainwater tank overflows in April but is empty by July.
Kiosk attendant opens late most weekdays.
Boiling water costs too much charcoal for us.
Neighbours fight over the queue order every morning.

case.why: Probes the kind-dependent threshold. All 4 of P01's submissions fall within 14:00-14:15, so a window containing c holds 4. That reaches the enumerator threshold but not the participant threshold of 5, so burst must stay silent. An implementation that applies 4 to everyone, or looks up the threshold by the wrong kind, fires here. The other checks stay quiet. Durations of 240-285 s are at least the 180 s participant minimum. same_spot never fires for participants, and the points are distinct anyway. All points are inside Kondele. There are no shared content words, no voice notes, daytime times, and one device.
